verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS platform that stores customer corporate records, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for it. The pack has no evidence of any region or residency choice. References to jurisdictions, states, and the interactive registration map concern where entities are legally registered, not where Harbor stores customer data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
